summary: Test-writing change adds local-stub regression coverage and records the generated-client verification plan. The Swift toolchain is unavailable in this container, so Swift tests could not run.

references.result: The generated-client package dependencies are intentionally deferred to the implementation phase.
Provider ranked-results schema omits the typed fields required by the prose contract.
Replacement of hand-written transport models is deferred to the implementation phase.
Local MockURLProtocol tests cover manifest, recent sheets, capture creation, measurement upload, and judgment upload but were not executable because swift is absent.
Contract delta evidence is prepared for the implementation PR description; no PR exists in this no-push test-writing run.
